matrix_metadata.scope: Side Effect, Idempotency, and Failure Semantics Matrix

external_side_effects: Publishes HMAC-SHA256 salted entity hash to shared intelligence layer
Dispatches ALERT_CREATED webhook notification if subscribers exist
operations.idempotency_contract: Sliding-window deduplication (300s window). Duplicate events increment count rather than inserting conflicting rows.
operations.failure_semantics: Atomic per alert batch; fails closed on Redis connection failure.

internal_side_effects: Initializes cryptographic genesis block in timeline
operations.idempotency_contract: Bounded 24-hour IdempotencyService header key. Exact payload match returns cached JSON; payload mismatch returns HTTP 409.
operations.failure_semantics: Releases in-progress lock on unhandled exception; does not leave partial case.

internal_side_effects: Appends cryptographically chained event to case.timeline
operations.idempotency_contract: Optimistic concurrency via expected_status precondition. Returns HTTP 409 Conflict if current status differs.
operations.failure_semantics: Fails closed if state transition is illegal or Four-Eyes signature requirement not satisfied.

operations.idempotency_contract: Terminal states strictly immutable. Once resolved, subsequent resolution or transition attempts raise TerminalCaseImmutableError.

external_side_effects: None (Local generation and preparation only; no direct FIU submission gateway)
operations.idempotency_contract: Atomic filesystem write using .tmp rename. Regenerating report produces verified bit-accurate package or updated timestamp.
operations.failure_semantics: Rejected upfront with HTTP 400 if case is in false positive or unreviewed status.

external_side_effects: Outbound HTTP POST to subscriber target_url with X-CFI-Signature-256 and X-CFI-Event-Id
operations.idempotency_contract: At-least-once transport with deterministic stable event ID (evt_<hash(tenant:type:id)>) enabling downstream exactly-once deduplication.
operations.failure_semantics: Non-blocking: delivery timeout or remote failure logs warning and does not abort caller business transaction.
